title: BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to an escheatment of unclaimed monies in the amount of $4,336,607.11 from the Los Angeles Police Department…
text:
[Council File 26-1432]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to an escheatment of unclaimed monies in the amount of $4,336,607.11 from the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) Unclaimed Monies Seized Incidental to Arrest Fund to the City’s General Fund.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. INSTRUCT the LAPD and the City Treasurer to process the sum of $4,336,607.11 from the Unclaimed Monies Seized Incidental to Arrest Trust Fund No. 7772.
2. REQUEST the Controller to transfer all identified eligible monies to the General Fund, Fund No. 100/70, Revenue Source Code 4834.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the Office of Finance. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Moves $4.34 million in unclaimed money held by the LAPD from seized-property funds into the city's General Fund.
